title: PolarisIdPrimitives
description: Identifier and time primitives shared by all POLARIS core contracts.
$comment: بدائل المعرفات المشتركة. UUID فقط لمنع المعرفات الحرة غير القابلة للتتبع.

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: Lowercase RFC 4122 UUID. Uppercase and non-UUID identifiers are rejected.

CorrelationId.title: CorrelationId
CorrelationId.description: Stable identifier for one end-to-end causal chain: IPC -> Invocation -> Decision -> Audit.

CausationId.title: CausationId
CausationId.description: Identifier of the immediately preceding message that caused this one.

IdempotencyKey.title: IdempotencyKey
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable across retries of the same logical operation. Never changes when `attempt` changes.

SemVer.title: SemVer
SemVer.description: Exact three-part semantic version. Ranges are not permitted in contract payloads.

ContractVersion.title: ContractVersion
ContractVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR contract version. Consumers reject unknown MAJOR and unknown-higher MINOR.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant, UTC only, trailing 'Z' required. Local offsets are rejected so ordering is total and canonicalisation is stable.

Slug.title: Slug
Slug.description: Lowercase namespaced identifier used for capability and policy names.
